timedMC.title: Beat the clock
timedMC.subtitle: 15 seconds per question. Some of these need the present continuous — but a few need the present simple instead. Watch for stative verbs.

questions.text: Look! The children        in the garden.
wrongReasons: Wrong tense: "Look!" signals something happening now — that needs the present continuous, not the present simple.
Subject-verb agreement: "the children" is plural, so the auxiliary is "are", not "is".
Missing -ing: after "are", use the -ing form — "playing", not "play".
